messages:
Lina (CSM): Heads-up — Axiom renewal hits next Tue. Customer asked to shorten to a 9-month alignment with their fiscal year and will submit PO AX-309 today. They also requested a clause that prevents auto-renewal.
Rob (AM): Sales approved a one-time 6% concession for 9mo. Anyone see a blocker?
Samir (Legal): No legal blocker. I'll prepare a short 9mo addendum with prorate language and explicit no-auto-renew wording.
June (Finance): Finance needs billing entity and VAT/EIN to issue invoice. Net30 requested by procurement. June (Finance): I'll draft invoice placeholder and attach once PO arrives.
Lina (CSM): Procurement asked if we can show pro rata line items and add a memo that seats are billable monthly. June: can you do that?
June (Finance): Yes. I'll include pro rata lines and a memo about monthly seat billing.
Eva (Enablement): Customer asked for training within 7 business days of sign. I can prepare a 2-hour onboarding agenda and ROI one-pager. ETA EOD tomorrow for drafts.
Lina (CSM): Sending DocuSign with draft addendum + invoice placeholder + ROI link now.
DocuSign-bot: Envelope env_axiom_210012 created and sent to procurement@axiom.com (status: sent).
Rob (AM): If signing stalls >48h, propose sending pre-recorded onboarding + ROI preview to keep momentum, gate keys until payment clears.
Lina (CSM): Noted. Renewal tracker: status=waiting_on_signature, risk=medium, notes=9mo term + PO pending; invoice draft prepared; enablement requested post-sign. I'll follow up in 3h. /cc @Rob (AM) @Samir (Legal) @June (Finance) @Eva (Enablement)
